title: B Vitamins and Cognition
subtitle: Evidence, dosing, safety, interactions, and practical considerations for b vitamins and cognition.
evidence_strength: Established evidence shows B vitamin deficiencies impair cognition and supplementation corrects these deficits; moderate evidence exists for cognitive benefits in at-risk groups; emerging evidence with some conflicting results in healthy populations; ongoing research refining dosing and outcomes.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
